title: Butterbase MCP Client
description:
Connects to the Butterbase MCP server and exposes its backend tools for agent tool-calling.
Butterbase is an AI-optimized Backend-as-a-Service (managed database, authentication, object storage, serverless functions, RAG). The agent can create apps, evolve schemas, configure auth, deploy functions, and more, as tools named butterbase.<tool>.
This is a branded preset of the generic MCP Client (Streamable HTTP), so it shares the same implementation. Prerequisite: enable Developer Mode on your Butterbase app so the agent can create/modify resources.
